name: 高级 TM-EWM – 出库高级装运和收货 (7VF)
name_en: Advanced TM-EWM – Outbound Advanced Shipping and Receiving (7VF)
description_en_html:
Overview

Advanced Shipping and Receiving is an integrated, end-to-end process that allows users to send, receive, and transport products. It helps you to coordinate the process steps from arrival of trucks at the gate to the final goods receipt/goods issue in/from the warehouse. A truck that has posted arrival at a checkpoint can carry out both loading and unloading activities at a location, or it can deliver/consolidate goods from several warehouses at the same location.

This scope item describes a common outbound scenario for an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ordering material from a supplier at different times during a certain timespan. This scenario runs in the embedded OEM’s facilities with an advanced TM license and an Extended Warehouse Management license.

Key Process Flow

  • Create Sales Order
  • Create Outbound Delivery
  • Display Freight Unit
  • Display Warehouse Outbound Delivery
  • Create Freight Order with Consignment Order (Local)
  • Transportation Planning
  • Picking and packing
  • Loading and goods issue
  • Transportation Execution

Business Benefits

Advanced Shipping and Receiving simplifies communication between the Transportation Management (TM), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Inventory Management and Physical Inventory (MM-IM), and Logistics Execution (LE) application components embedded in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition. We need Materials Management (MM) and Sales and Distribution (SD) to create transportation requirements.

Exclude from Default Activation

Reason for Excluding from Default Activation

This scope item requires Advanced Transportation Management license.
description_zh_html:
概览

高级装运和收货是一个集成的端到端流程，允许用户发送、接收和运输产品。它可以帮助您协调从卡车到达门到仓库的最终收货/发货的流程步骤。已到达检查点的卡车可以在一个位置同时执行装货和卸货活动，也可以从同一位置的多个仓库交货/合并货物。

此范围项目描述了原始设备制造商 (OEM) 在特定时间跨度内的不同时间从供应商处订购物料的常见外向场景。此场景在具有高级 TM 许可证和高级仓库管理许可证的嵌入式 OEM 设施中运行。

关键流程流

  • 创建销售订单
  • 创建出库交货
  • 显示货运单位
  • 显示仓库出库交货
  • 创建含寄售订单的货运订单（本地）
  • 运输计划
  • 拣配和包装
  • 装货和发货
  • 运输执行

业务优势

高级装运和收货简化了 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中嵌入的运输管理 (TM)、高级仓库管理 (EWM)、库存管理和库存盘点 (MM-IM) 以及物流执行 (LE) 应用程序组件之间的通信。我们需要物料管理 (MM) 以及销售和分销 (SD) 来创建运输需求。

从默认激活中排除

从缺省激活中排除的原因

此范围项目需要高级运输管理许可证。
